backtest.target: next-year national net migration per 1,000 residents
backtest.feature_year_rule: features observed in year t; target observed in year t+1
backtest.evaluation_method: expanding-origin; each test year is predicted using only earlier target years; no random split
backtest.uncertainty_note: Metrics are pooled across chronological test origins; serial dependence and cross-country heterogeneity remain. Use block/cluster-aware intervals before strong claims.
backtest.interpretation: Macro-level predictive evaluation only. National net migration is not an individual or programme-specific outcome. Equal-weight EOM energy is an ordinal score, not a calibrated probability; its Spearman correlation is not a causal estimate. Weak performance is evidence against this operationalization, not proof that every EOM formulation fails.

limitation: Current WDI CSV includes observed values through 2025 for some indicators, but the four series used for cost, policy, institutions and stability are absent from this CSV and retained only from the prior source vintage through 2023. Therefore no same-year six-component 2024/2025 energy ranking can be defended.
